results.name: Eight public helpline call placements remain unique and use the central number
No visitor measurement choice, refusal state or GPC gate remains
A production visit starts GA4, Ads and call measurement exactly once
An existing Google tag is reused without losing configuration or events
Forwarding-number replacement changes only central links and tracked calls still fire
Every approved placement produces one bounded event without blocking dialling
Existing and new ordinary campaign tuples enter the bounded journey envelope
Google click IDs remain in the landing URL for the granted Google tag and never enter custom payloads
Private campaign values and unknown optional fields never enter analytics or storage
Standard UTMs, new numeric campaign IDs, click IDs and original case are preserved without exporting click IDs
Duplicate optional identifiers are ignored individually and cannot poison an ordinary visit
Same source keeps its original landing/capture; expiry and storage failure remain bounded
Protection module and canonical collector initialize once without invoking a vendor
Labelled QA, preview, apex and unrelated routes remain unmeasured

scope: Automatic first-party helpline measurement tests. Third-party requests and receiving-platform ingestion require separate live verification; a phone-link event does not prove a connected call.
